raw_text: Wagner PMC elements redeploying from Deir ez-Zor, Syria to Jufra air base in central Libya. Flight tracking data shows IL-76 cargo aircraft making Latakia-Jufra runs since September 14. Satellite imagery confirms new vehicle parks and tented camps near Es Sider oil terminal. Post-Prigozhin Africa Corps consolidation continues.
